name: CROSSIA
summary:
CROSSIA is a VR entertainment platform where fans can step into a character’s world and enjoy special experiences in immersive virtual spaces.

Inside CROSSIA, you can purchase in-app coins, use them to get tickets, and join character-focused experiences such as VR photo sessions, autograph-style events, and more.

Designed for fans who want more than simply watching from a distance, CROSSIA offers a new way to feel closer to the characters and worlds you love.

Experiences may include:

• VR photo sessions
